subject: Asteria: action slate + draft doc for review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Asteria: action slate + draft doc for review

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great discussion on where Redwood could reduce inference cost and speed up your clinical NLP pipelines. I put together an initial action slate to make the next 60 days explicit: scope, owners, success metrics, and a proposed close timeline.

Attached: action-plan-template.gdoc (editable Google Doc) and a starter pricing.xlsx showing a 30/60/90-day pilot option.

What I need from you to finalize the draft:
- Confirm primary stakeholders (POC, procurement, security, and data owners)
- Any mandatory procurement terms we should pre-surface (e.g., SLA language, data residency)
- Your preferred pilot start week (we suggested week of Jan 26)

I linked an editable doc below so we can co-author in real time: https://docs.google.com/document/d/asteria-map-v1 (view/comment/edit set for Asteria).

Proposed high-level timeline (editable in the doc):
- Week 1 (Jan 26): Pilot kickoff + access + brief tech onboarding (CS lead: Hannah)
- Weeks 2–5: Integration & evaluation (data syncs, 1–2 sample prompts, latency/cost baseline)
- Week 6: Evaluation review + decision (red/amber/green)

If that looks OK I’ll update the doc to include your stakeholders and add a short acceptance checklist for the pilot.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: action-plan-template.gdoc (GDoc), pricing.xlsx (Excel)

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@asteriahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@asteriahealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@asteriahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asteria: action slate + draft doc for review

Thanks Marissa — really appreciate the quick turnaround and clear timeline. A few requests from our side before we co-edit the doc: 

1) Security/compliance checkpoint — we need SOC 2/ISO blurb and any standard connectivity diagrams (VPN, VPC peering). Can you include an evidence stub or pointer for our security team?

2) Procurement: our procurement team needs to see the exact pilot terms (liability/term/termination). I attached our SOW template (SOW_terms.docx) — can you review and flag any conflicts?

3) Timeline: Jan 26 works as a target kickoff, but we may need one extra week for procurement review. Can you show a +1 week alternate in the doc?

4) Stakeholders (confirming):
   - Alex Torres (POC / Clinical ML)
   - Emily Zhao (Procurement)
   - Dr. Samantha Lee (Head of Data & Analytics)
   - Asteria IT Security (security@asteriahealth.com)

If you can add the security checklist and the +1 week alternate timeline I’ll get procurement to review the SOW this week.

On the SOW: we typically need an explicit audit-log clause and a clause on data retention/ERASURE for pilot data — can you confirm Redwood’s default positions on those two?

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Torres
Director, Clinical ML | Asteria Health
alex.torres@asteriahealth.com
Attachment: SOW_terms.docx (Doc)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Asteria IT Security <security@asteriahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Asteria: action slate + draft doc for review

Alex — great notes. I updated the draft with a security/compliance checkpoint and a +1 week alternate timeline — link below. I also added a short section called "Procurement flags" that calls out the audit log and data erasure language so your procurement team can see our standard wording and suggest redlines.

Editable draft (new version): https://docs.google.com/document/d/asteria-map-v1 (v1.1 - "security & procurement flags")

Quick answers: 
- Audit logs: Redwood records token-level audit logs for hosted customers and exposes them via the console; for private deployments we can arrange custom retention settings and log export to your SIEM. 
- Data erasure: pilot data is scoped to temporary storage with a 30-day retention after project end by default; we can shorten this for pilot artifacts on request and include a formal erasure clause in the SOW.

I added the following owners inside the doc — please confirm or edit the owner column: 
- Alex Torres — Clinical ML (POC)
- Emily Zhao — Procurement (contracts)
- Dr. Samantha Lee — Head of Data & Analytics (success review)
- Hannah Schmitt — Customer Success (onboarding & evaluation)
- Rishi Malhotra — Sales Lead (commercial approvals)

Proposed pilot acceptance metrics (added under "success criteria"):
- Latency: median request latency under 250ms for 95th pct tokens (closed-loop measurement)
- Cost: reduce per-token inference cost by at least 20% vs current baseline
- Quality: pass a prompt-based evaluation suite with >= 90% agreement rate vs annotated sample set

Attachments in the doc: I uploaded a version of the action slate (asteria-map-v1.gdoc) and a sample pricing workbook. Let me know who on procurement will be the primary redliner and I’ll drop the SOW into the DocuSign-ready folder.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Links: Google Doc (v1.1): https://docs.google.com/document/d/asteria-map-v1
Attachments referenced: asteria-map-v1.gdoc, pricing.xlsx

Adding the CS perspective — good to meet you Alex. Short note on onboarding & runbook items I put into the doc: 

- Access: temporary API key + scoped VPC instructions (we'll provide scripts)
- Integration checklist: sample payloads, synthetic dataset for early QA, KV cache expectations
- Evaluation cadence: two weekly syncs during integration (weeks 2 & 4) + mid-pilot checkpoint in week 5
- Success handoff: if pilot metrics land in green, we propose a 60-day production ramp after procurement sign-off

I also added a short "pilot milestones" tab to the GDoc that spells out what we deliver each week (tech checklist + CS tasks). Happy to run a 30-min working session with your engineers this week to walk the integration checklist. What times work for the team?

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
